features: Fixed proactive-message inbox button beside history in assistant header.
Numeric red badge uses open + unread item count; list keeps read-but-open tasks accessible.
Inbox lists every open task without three-item truncation; main chat no longer renders task banners.
History/inbox/tools panels are mutually exclusive; close or Escape returns to the preserved conversation scroll and input.
Entering a task uses the existing native mark/read handling; opening the inbox alone does not mark anything.

browserSteward.scope: Existing 15 scenarios plus long-chat inbox test; one card-height issue corrected then focused tests passed.

limits: UI checks used isolated browser/native-command fixtures.
No personal conversations, queues or cloud records accessed or modified.
Native database schema and message generation/processing behavior unchanged.
No GitHub publish, commit or push.
